method: Manually authored source-branch, card-face, and physical-slot expectations. Formatting inserts the full POLICY JSON literal into every success input; it does not execute TypeScript or calculate expected outcomes.
scope: Standalone post-fill bonus and final numeric sort only; no clearing, refill, full rethink, TurnEnd, RNG stream or old-session execution.
runtimeAssumption: Success and input-refusal expectations assume the required trusted proxy detector is available. Otherwise unsupported-runtime takes precedence before inspecting the input.
expectedFields: paperExpected is a selected output projection including the complete audit, not a runtime-generated receipt or complete Success DTO. Exact policy and evidence on a success are the corresponding exported constants; no execution or runtime validation is claimed.
inputPolicy: Each success input carries the full exact policy. Cases are independent; no case feeds another case.
refusalRecipeMeaning: Every refusal is explicitly notDirectInput. To understand its conceptual input, copy the full input of baseSuccessCase and apply the listed replacement descriptions from left to right. Empty path means replace the entire input. Recipes are paper descriptions only and were not applied or executed.
identityMeaning: audit.inputHand is the original checkpoint. audit.sort.before is after optional physical-slot-1 replacement. sourceIndices maps final output positions to that pre-final-sort physical-slot array, not pre-refill card identities. Equal-card ties are engine policy only.
randomnessMeaning: rawResults contains supplied RandBool(40) boolean call results, never numeric random draws. Exactly one is consumed for positive-timer Calm even for an invalid game topic. externalRngConsumed is zero; no bound-100 mapping, probability or native-stream assertion is made.

successCases.purpose: Timer zero gates off before personality and consumes no result.
Calm alone is insufficient: timer zero consumes no result.
Timer-zero branch is shared by Bold; final sort is still present.
Minimum signed-32 topic is admitted even when the timer gate prevents any boolean use.
Positive timer does not consume a result for Timid.
Positive timer does not consume a result for Bold.
Positive timer does not consume a result for Reckless.
Topic 0 with false consumes one supplied boolean and never assigns slot 1.
Topic 1 with false consumes one supplied boolean and preserves the checkpoint.
Topic 2 false also covers maximum admitted hand length and intermediate positive timer 2.
Assignment still applies when slot 1 already holds Story3: replacement is nonnull and changed is false.
Physical input slot 1 becomes Logic3 before sorting; original slot 2 moves ahead of it.
Duplicate 3 and 9 faces keep deterministic pre-final-sort source-slot identity; the overwritten slot 1 precedes equal 9 faces from slots 5 and 6.
An invalid game topic still consumes true; range rejection occurs only after the supplied boolean was consumed.
An invalid game topic still consumes false; false short-circuits the topic-range outcome, so the reason is boolean-result-false.
After a changed Story3 overwrite, physical slot 2 moves earlier and the new 3 from slot 1 wins the engine-only equal-face tie over slot 3.

refusalCases.explanation: Positive-timer Calm requires one result even when no replacement would ultimately be made.
Array length greater than one is rejected before gate-dependent count comparison.
A well-shaped boolean is still unexpected for positive-timer non-Calm.
The supplied value must be boolean; integer 1 is neither a boolean nor a supported RNG mapping.
Matching policy id does not authorize any structural policy change.
Input must already be sorted; the final sort does not repair an invalid entry checkpoint.
First slot must be the reserved Rethink code 0.
Only the first slot may contain reserved code 0.
The source empty-slot sentinel is not an admitted post-fill card.
The admitted rethink checkpoint must contain at least one ordinary topic card 1..9.
Three total active slots are outside the explicit 4..7 checkpoint domain.
Code 15 is outside the admitted 1..14 nonreserved card range.
The timer admission range is integer 0..4, an engine boundary rather than a source clamp.
Safe data detachment rejects every fractional number before field-specific signed-32 validation.
A safe integer outside signed 32-bit range is not an admitted topic checkpoint.
The input root must be the closed object contract, not an array.

nonSerializedSafetyBoundaries: Proxies, getters, executable values, symbols, sparse arrays, cycles, negative zero and nonplain objects are not represented as executable fixtures in this JSON.
Input budgets and unsupported-runtime behavior are documented engine limits; no checker, validator or runtime probe was run.
